name: UVA Advance Pre-College Program
org: University of Virginia Summer and Special Academic Programs
what_you_do: This is a four-week residential program on UVA's campus. Rising juniors and seniors take one core class and one elective. Classes give letter grades and six transferable credits. The program also has college readiness workshops.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors in good standing with a minimum 3.5 GPA in a college prep curriculum, age 15 or older on the first day and 18 or younger on the last day.
pay_detail: 2027 total: $7,410 for Virginia residents, $15,522 for others. It covers tuition, fees, housing and meals. Small number of need-based aid packages. No aid for international students.
deadline_text: Summer 2027: application opens Dec 1, 2026; deadline Mar 1, 2027; teacher recommendation Mar 5, 2027; decisions Mar 31, 2027; accept by Apr 15, 2027.
how_to_apply: Online application with transcripts, one teacher or administrator recommendation uploaded by the recommender, and a 350 to 500 word essay. Financial aid materials are due by March 1.
notes: You live in a dorm with a 10 pm curfew. Travel, books, laundry and spending money cost extra. Questions: UVaAdvance@virginia.edu, 434-243-2241.
